title: Prior-Fitted and Frozen Scorers for Multimodal Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal contrastive learning typically relies on manually specified scoring functions, such as cosine similarity, to quantify the similarity between representations from different modalities. Several such functions have been recently proposed to extend contrastive learning beyond two modalities. In principle, however, any function that assigns high compatibility to matched samples and low compatibility to mismatched ones could serve as a scorer. Motivated by this broader view, we instantiate the scorer with a Transformer and find that even a randomly initialized model, when kept frozen, can outperform strong handcrafted multimodal contrastive baselines, whereas optimizing the scorer jointly with the encoders is less effective. translated_title: 面向多模态对比学习的先验拟合与冻结评分器
translated_abstract: 多模态对比学习通常依赖人工指定的评分函数（如余弦相似度）来量化来自不同模态的表示之间的相似性。近来已有若干此类函数被提出，以将对比学习扩展至两个模态之外。然而从原则上讲，任何能对匹配样本赋予高兼容性、对不匹配样本赋予低兼容性的函数都可以充当评分器。受这一更宽泛视角的启发，我们用一个Transformer来实例化评分器，发现即使是一个随机初始化且保持冻结的模型，也能超越强大的手工设计多模态对比学习基线，而将评分器与编码器进行联合优化的效果反而较差。基于这一观察，我们提出了先验拟合评分器：一个在由结构因果模型（SCM）先验生成的合成多模态数据上进行预训练、然后再迁移使用的Transformer评分器。
tldr: 提出先验拟合评分器（PFS），在结构因果模型先验生成的合成多模态数据上预训练一个冻结的Transformer作为相似度评分器，无需手工设计评分函数即可超越现有多模态对比学习基线。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Prior-Fitted Scorer (PFS), a frozen Transformer pre-trained on synthetic multimodal data generated from structural causal model (SCM) priors, which serves as a similarity scorer for multimodal contrastive learning and outperforms handcrafted scoring baselines.
